data.title: Jobcenter notice of changed Bürgergeld benefits
data.summary: Jobcenter Musterlingen recalculated Lea Muster's Bürgergeld for 1 November 2025 to 30 April 2026 because heating cost advances changed. The monthly entitlement is €1,126.40 from 1 November 2025. Bank statements are due by 5 November 2025.
data.explanation: This is an amended benefit decision (Änderungsbescheid). Your monthly entitlement is now €1,126.40 from 1 November 2025. You must submit your last three months of bank statements by 5 November 2025. Without them, benefits from December cannot continue to be granted. If you disagree with the decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at the Jobcenter. The app shows until when. Consider getting advice from a benefits counselling service if unsure.

items.title: Submit bank statements
items.action: Submit your bank statements for the last three months to the Jobcenter.
items.consequence: Without these documents, benefits from December cannot continue to be granted.
items.quote: Bitte reichen Sie bis zum 05.11.2025 die Kontoauszüge der letzten drei Monate ein.

items.title: Objection period (Widerspruch)
items.action: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person at Jobcenter Musterlingen.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final.
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann jede betroffene Person innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erheben.
